tau.label: Pinned official tau3 retail/airline task subset with custom frozen v4 agent scaffold

method.taskClustering: domain plus official task ID; both repetitions resampled together
method.benchmarkScope: Pinned upstream tau-bench retail/airline task subset; prior task exposure is audited separately and a new namespace does not establish unseen task IDs
method.predictionAccuracy: Native task accuracy is separate from next-action prediction accuracy; this report does not infer prediction accuracy from task reward
method.interval: pointwise percentile task-cluster bootstrap, 95%; not multiplicity adjusted
method.pass1: observed success fraction across every declared trial, including failures; equal-task mean pass1 when each task has the same repetition count
method.bothTrials: fraction of tasks with exactly two distinct trials that both succeeded; not pass-at-least-once
method.goldRecall: multiset recall against one upstream reference trajectory, assistant actions only; full arguments ignore compare_args and include no policy/path correctness claim
method.toolRate: fraction of native tool responses without an error; not policy compliance or unique-path action accuracy
method.timing: recorded failures retain measured duration; absent times remain null, never zero-filled; paired timing/diagnostic differences use only repetitions measured in both arms
method.physicalCounts: authoritative_tool plus speculative_native_tool attempted executions; wrapper timings are nested and excluded from physical totals; freshness checks are lease validation
method.speculationUsefulness: Exact consumed promotions are a lower bound. Exposed evidence can eliminate authoritative calls without promotion; evidence consumption is unknown. Unpromoted calls are not all waste. Scheduler waste candidates are unexposed/unconsumed jobs, not necessarily executed calls.
method.assertions: Evaluate assertion coverage only when NL_ASSERTION is selected in the recorded reward basis; stored assertions outside that basis require no judge. Preserve native rewards and raw coverage flags.
method.cost: usage estimates and retained trial maxima from closed outcomes; no invoice or shared-ledger reconciliation

twoTrialConsistency.meaning: Observed pass^2 is both-successful tasks divided by eligible two-trial tasks. It is not squared pooled pass1 or at-least-once success.

officialRewardAudit.meaning: Raw upstream reward availability and values are descriptive. Primary success still requires reward one and no execution, drain, or evaluation failure; missing rewards remain primary failures.

nativeAssertionAudit.meaning: Applicability follows the recorded reward basis. Raw judgeCoverage flags remain unchanged; false may mean NL_ASSERTION was not selected. Empty selected assertion sets need no judge. Assertion results are not an exhaustive policy audit.

speculationAudit.meaning: Consumed promotion receipts count exact tool reuse, a lower bound on usefulness. Exposed evidence may eliminate later authoritative calls; actual evidence consumption is unknown. Source wastedCalls is summarized as reportedUnpromotedCalls, not total waste. Scheduler waste candidates were unexposed and unconsumed at close; job counts are not physical execution counts.

physicalCallsPerSuccess.meaning: All physical native tool attempts, including failed trials, divided by successful trial executions. Nested snapshot wrappers and freshness lease checks are excluded. Partial telemetry is not silently zero-filled.

benchmark.scope: Original published tasks and native evaluator, custom frozen agent scaffold, selected test subset

selection.label: Pinned official tau retail/airline test subset; held out from frozen v4 controller and prior live execution; historically public-exposed
claimsExcluded: verified reproduction of PASTE or Salesforce architecture

retail.source: Existing public replay group_id only; inferred normalized request groups, not official parent genealogy
retail.limitation: No claim of semantic independence from every custom training task or official family genealogy. Existing groups prevent known normalized-template duplicates only.

airline.source: Existing public replay group_id only; inferred normalized request groups, not official parent genealogy
airline.limitation: No claim of semantic independence from every custom training task or official family genealogy. Existing groups prevent known normalized-template duplicates only.

selectionMethod.input: UTF-8 compact JSON [studyId, seed, domain, stringTaskId], no ASCII escaping
selectionMethod.sort: Ascending digest, then accept first seven distinct prior public request groups within each domain
selectionMethod.eligible: Pinned official test IDs excluding all controller train/selection/calibration and prior live IDs plus known normalized-request relatives

plannedDesign.armOrdering: Harness must freeze balanced randomized paired order before dispatch

costCalibration.rule: ceil_0.25(max(1.25, 1.25*largest completed applicable development trial cost))
costCalibration.olderRoundsExcludedExplicitly: V3 development rounds 1 and 2 contained three unknown-cost runs under earlier runtime/protocol iterations. They remain archived; this new study precommits the two named completed cohorts as its cost-calibration population, and makes no claim that those earlier costs were resolved.

selection.freezePolicy: Selection is immutable before new live trials; no training, scoring, annotation or runtime updates; provider failures and task failures retained

cost.meaning: Recorded request usage, not an invoice. Unknown trials retain their full reservation; known subtotals are not added twice.

base.meaning: Refresh and consumption lease checks are added work, not physical native tool executions.

paste.meaning: Refresh and consumption lease checks are added work, not physical native tool executions.

salesforce.meaning: Refresh and consumption lease checks are added work, not physical native tool executions.

bfcl.label: BFCL v4 multiple/irrelevance subset, frozen research actor component, not full GoalSpec or overall BFCL score

manifest.label: BFCL v4 multiple/irrelevance subset, frozen research actor component, not full GoalSpec or overall BFCL score
manifest.selection: SHA256 ID-only ordering before answer loading, 32 per category
manifest.protocol: Single turn, native Responses tool calls, no system prompt or tool execution; strict=false preserves optional fields
manifest.checkerAdapter: Unmodified upstream AST checker; isolated model registry contains only underscore_to_dot=True; exact upstream converter function ASTs

limitations: Two-category deterministic subset, not an overall BFCL leaderboard score
Actor/tool-call component only; no GoalSpec scheduler, memory, goals or live task-completion claim
All declared failures retained; no retries of completed cases

corpus.license_text: CC BY-NC 4.0; research purposes only; preserve Salesforce APIGen-MT attribution and source-card restrictions. Card SHA256: fcda213ea7911ad16baff240cd352fbd639acf5b6313211277ed600023756c77

duplicates.crossSourceNearDuplicateAudit: not established; no certified heldout claim

semantics.compatibility: Static graph binding only. Temporary native binder version is an algorithm compatibility view; final candidates retain unverified APIGen scope, no authorization, and cannot execute.
semantics.gates: READ and learned useful/readiness thresholds only; imitation labels from native training. No claim of actual native readiness, causal usefulness, latency savings, or authorization.
semantics.invalid: Malformed/out-of-catalog actions remain unknown-label checkpoints and in coverage denominators. Their unverified results cannot seed later proposals. No aliases or target-dependent candidate insertion.
semantics.labels: Strict JSON argument object and original supplied catalog schema without coercion. Native-read subset only; assistant text and valid writes/compute are NO_READ. Source-reported verification only.
semantics.license: CC BY-NC 4.0, research only. Salesforce/APIGen-MT-5k source and pinned dataset card restrictions retained.
semantics.population: Every assistant or function_call source message, with all 5000 episodes retained. These are source-message checkpoints, not reconstructed native actor batches.
semantics.uncertainty: Provisional action-family clustered intervals. Dataset families are not certified independent heldout task families. APIGen task success is not measured.

interpretation: Zero-provider frozen-controller transfer diagnostic over Salesforce/APIGen-MT-5k public source tapes, not APIGen actor execution or task success.

Every assistant text or function_call source row is a checkpoint. Source formatting can split text and calls that one native actor batch would combine; NO_READ calibration is therefore distribution-shifted.

Candidate schemas and arguments are validated against the source episode catalog. The static native binder proposes only its retail/airline read vocabulary. Source environment execution and authorization are unverified.
Out-of-catalog or malformed actions remain unknown-label records in source/checkpoint coverage, excluded from label-dependent accuracy denominators rather than misclassified as NO_READ.
Unknown source results are not consumed as trusted binding observations. Later affected prefixes are flagged; catalog-clean episode sensitivity is reported separately.

Exact normalized duplicate records remain in primary metrics; duplicate counts are disclosed. Provisional action-family bootstrap intervals are pointwise, not certified task-family heldout inference or multiplicity corrected.

Ungated top-k scores measure candidate ranking; gated exact top-1 also requires the frozen binary READ, useful-within-two and learned readiness thresholds. These are imitation gates, not causal utility or permission.

Tool cross-entropy is a normalized sum of independent next-action candidate confidences, smoothed by 0.001 per supplied supported read tool. It estimates predictive cross-entropy, not true conditional entropy or a joint argument likelihood.

The current-prior ranker shares exactly the same bounded candidate pool, tie-breaks by candidate ID and predicts READ whenever that pool is nonempty. It is a mechanical heuristic, not a Salesforce or PASTE implementation.

No model fitting, threshold selection, native task reward, latency savings or superiority across all metrics is inferred. Research-only CC BY-NC 4.0 lineage and source-reported verification are preserved.

limitations: BFCL measures a 64-case frozen research-actor component subset with upstream grades. GoalSpec candidate generation, goals, memory, prefetch execution and learned controller were not active; this cannot establish a GoalSpec-over-baseline improvement or an overall BFCL score.

Seven of nine misses involve whether to call: five unnecessary calls on irrelevance cases and two missed calls on multiple-function-choice cases. One over-call and one argument-value mismatch complete the failures. No grades are reinterpreted or replaced.
Direct calculation or asking for clarification can fail this AST tool-selection contract; this audit does not infer end-user task success or override the reference grader.

The APIGen frozen-controller transfer diagnostic improves ungated exact ranking and NO_READ specificity but loses read sensitivity and gated exact coverage. It uses different models, tasks and checkpoint definitions from BFCL. The abstention patterns cannot be combined into a shared accuracy or causal claim.

A stronger action-selection/abstention contract and argument constraints are possible future development targets, but these benchmark cases must not become tuning data for a score still described as held out. No changes, retraining, prompt tuning, reruns or provider calls were performed.

Only the closed BFCL report/predictions and aggregate APIGen report were inspected. No live tau artifacts, replay score files, training tapes, encrypted reasoning, provider continuation content or benchmark source labels were used in this audit.
